segments.dn16:4.12.1: Tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā bhoganagare viharanto ānande cetiye etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti –
segments.dn16:4.12.5: Paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.dn16:4.13.1: Atha kho bhagavā bhoganagare yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.13.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn16:4.13.4: Atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena pāvā tadavasari.
segments.dn16:4.13.5: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane.
segments.dn16:4.14.1: Assosi kho cundo kammāraputto – “bhagavā kira pāvaṃ anuppatto, pāvāyaṃ viharati mayhaṃ ambavane”ti.
segments.dn16:4.14.2: Atha kho cundo kammāraputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn16:4.14.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
segments.dn16:4.14.4: Atha kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.15.1: “adhivāsetu me, bhante, bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.dn16:4.16.1: Atha kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.dn16:4.17.1: Atha kho cundo kammāraputto tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā pahūtañca sūkaramaddavaṃ bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi –
segments.dn16:4.18.1: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena cundassa kammāraputtassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.dn16:4.18.2: Nisajja kho bhagavā cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.18.3: “yaṃ te, cunda, sūkaramaddavaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena maṃ parivisa.
segments.dn16:4.18.4: Yaṃ panaññaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisā”ti.
segments.dn16:4.18.5: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato paṭissutvā yaṃ ahosi sūkaramaddavaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena bhagavantaṃ parivisi.
segments.dn16:4.18.6: Yaṃ panaññaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisi.
segments.dn16:4.19.1: Atha kho bhagavā cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.19.2: “yaṃ te, cunda, sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇāhi.
segments.dn16:4.19.3: Nāhaṃ taṃ, cunda, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa taṃ paribhuttaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassā”ti.
segments.dn16:4.19.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato paṭissutvā yaṃ ahosi sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn16:4.19.5: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.dn16:4.20.1: Atha kho bhagavato cundassa kammāraputtassa bhattaṃ bhuttāvissa kharo ābādho uppajji, lohitapakkhandikā pabāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā.
segments.dn16:4.20.2: Tā sudaṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi avihaññamāno.
segments.dn16:4.20.3: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.20.5: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn16:4.20.12: Virecamāno [viriccamāno (sī. syā. ka.), viriñcamāno (?)] bhagavā avoca,
segments.dn16:4.21.1: Atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.21.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, ānanda, catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapehi, kilantosmi, ānanda, nisīdissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.21.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapesi.
segments.dn16:4.22.1: Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.22.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, ānanda, pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsitosmi, ānanda, pivissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.22.3: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.22.4: “idāni, bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni, taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
segments.dn16:4.22.5: Ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā [kakuthā (sī. pī.)] nadī avidūre acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setodakā [setakā (sī.)] suppatitthā ramaṇīyā.
segments.dn16:4.22.6: Ettha bhagavā pānīyañca pivissati, gattāni ca sītī [sītaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] karissatī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.23.1: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.23.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, ānanda, pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsitosmi, ānanda, pivissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.23.3: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.23.4: “idāni, bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni, taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
segments.dn16:4.23.5: Ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā nadī avidūre acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setodakā suppatitthā ramaṇīyā.
segments.dn16:4.23.6: Ettha bhagavā pānīyañca pivissati, gattāni ca sītīkarissatī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.24.1: Tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.24.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, ānanda, pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsitosmi, ānanda, pivissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.24.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā pattaṃ gahetvā yena sā nadikā tenupasaṅkami.
segments.dn16:4.24.4: Atha kho sā nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā, āyasmante ānande upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha [sandati (syā.)].
segments.dn16:4.25.2: “acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
segments.dn16:4.25.3: Ayañhi sā nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā mayi upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandatī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.25.4: Pattena pānīyaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.25.5: “acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
segments.dn16:4.25.6: Idāni sā bhante nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā mayi upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha.
segments.dn16:4.25.7: Pivatu bhagavā pānīyaṃ pivatu sugato pānīyan”ti.
segments.dn16:4.26.1: Tena rokho pana samayena pukkuso mallaputto āḷārassa kālāmassa sāvako kusinārāya pāvaṃ addhānamaggappaṭippanno hoti.
segments.dn16:4.26.2: Addasā kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ.
segments.dn16:4.26.3: Disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.26.4: “acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, santena vata, bhante, pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.
segments.dn16:4.27.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, āḷāro kālāmo addhānamaggappaṭippanno maggā okkamma avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn16:4.27.2: Atha kho, bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ nissāya nissāya atikkamiṃsu.
segments.dn16:4.27.3: Atha kho, bhante, aññataro puriso tassa sakaṭasatthassa [sakaṭasatassa (ka.)] piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchanto yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.27.12: ‘So tvaṃ, bhante, saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkantāni neva addasa, na pana saddaṃ assosi;
segments.dn16:4.27.13: apisu [api hi (sī. syā. pī.)] te, bhante, saṅghāṭi rajena okiṇṇā’ti?
segments.dn16:4.27.15: Atha kho, bhante, tassa purisassa etadahosi –
segments.dn16:4.27.16: ‘acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, santena vata bho pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.
segments.dn16:4.27.17: Yatra hi nāma saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkantāni neva dakkhati, na pana saddaṃ sossatī’ti!
segments.dn16:4.27.18: Āḷāre kālāme uḷāraṃ pasādaṃ pavedetvā pakkāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.28.2: katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā –
segments.dn16:4.28.3: yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkantāni neva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyya;
segments.dn16:4.28.4: yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu [vijjutāsu (sī. syā. pī.)] niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā neva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā”ti?
segments.dn16:4.29.1: “Kiñhi, bhante, karissanti pañca vā sakaṭasatāni cha vā sakaṭasatāni satta vā sakaṭasatāni aṭṭha vā sakaṭasatāni nava vā sakaṭasatāni [nava vā sakaṭasatāni dasa vā sakaṭasatāni (sī.)], sakaṭasahassaṃ vā sakaṭasatasahassaṃ vā.
segments.dn16:4.29.2: Atha kho etadeva dukkarataraṃ ceva durabhisambhavatarañca yo saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā neva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā”ti.
segments.dn16:4.30.2: Tena kho pana samayena deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā avidūre bhusāgārassa dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā [balibaddā (sī. pī.)].
segments.dn16:4.30.3: Atha kho, pukkusa, ātumāya mahājanakāyo nikkhamitvā yena te dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā tenupasaṅkami.
segments.dn16:4.31.1: Tena kho panāhaṃ, pukkusa, samayena bhusāgārā nikkhamitvā bhusāgāradvāre abbhokāse caṅkamāmi.
segments.dn16:4.31.2: Atha kho, pukkusa, aññataro puriso tamhā mahājanakāyā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho ahaṃ, pukkusa, taṃ purisaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.dn16:4.32.1: ‘kiṃ nu kho eso, āvuso, mahājanakāyo sannipatito’ti?
segments.dn16:4.32.2: ‘Idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā.
segments.dn16:4.32.14: ‘So tvaṃ, bhante, saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā neva addasa, na pana saddaṃ assosī’ti?
segments.dn16:4.33.2: ‘acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, santena vata bho pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.
segments.dn16:4.33.3: Yatra hi nāma saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā neva dakkhati, na pana saddaṃ sossatī’ti [suṇissati (syā.)].
segments.dn16:4.33.4: Mayi uḷāraṃ pasādaṃ pavedetvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.34.1: Evaṃ vutte pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.34.2: “esāhaṃ, bhante, yo me āḷāre kālāme pasādo taṃ mahāvāte vā ophuṇāmi sīghasotāya [siṅghasotāya (ka.)] vā nadiyā pavāhemi.
segments.dn16:4.34.4: Seyyathāpi, bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti; evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.dn16:4.34.5: Esāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.dn16:4.34.6: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.
segments.dn16:4.35.1: Atha kho pukkuso mallaputto aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.35.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, bhaṇe, siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āharā”ti.
segments.dn16:4.35.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho so puriso pukkusassa mallaputtassa paṭissutvā taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āhari [āharasi (ka.)].
segments.dn16:4.35.4: Atha kho pukkuso mallaputto taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato upanāmesi –
segments.dn16:4.35.5: “idaṃ, bhante, siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.dn16:4.35.6: “Tena hi, pukkusa, ekena maṃ acchādehi, ekena ānandan”ti.
segments.dn16:4.35.7: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavato paṭissutvā ekena bhagavantaṃ acchādeti, ekena āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ.
segments.dn16:4.36.1: Atha kho bhagavā pukkusaṃ mallaputtaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
segments.dn16:4.36.2: Atha kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.dn16:4.37.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando acirapakkante pukkuse mallaputte taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmesi.
segments.dn16:4.37.2: Taṃ bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitaṃ hataccikaṃ viya [vītaccikaṃviya (sī. pī.)] khāyati.
segments.dn16:4.37.3: Atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:4.37.4: “acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, yāva parisuddho, bhante, tathāgatassa chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
segments.dn16:4.37.5: Idaṃ, bhante, siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitaṃ hataccikaṃ viya khāyatī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.37.6: “Evametaṃ, ānanda, evametaṃ, ānanda dvīsu kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
segments.dn16:4.38.2: Yañca, ānanda, rattiṃ tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañca rattiṃ anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati.
segments.dn16:4.38.3: Imesu kho, ānanda, dvīsu kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
segments.dn16:4.38.4: “Ajja kho, panānanda, rattiyā pacchime yāme kusinārāyaṃ upavattane mallānaṃ sālavane antarena [antare (syā.)] yamakasālānaṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati [bhavissatīti (ka.)].
segments.dn16:4.38.6: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn16:4.39.1: Atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena kakudhā nadī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā kakudhaṃ nadiṃ ajjhogāhetvā nhatvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena ambavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
segments.dn16:4.39.3: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, cundaka, catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapehi, kilantosmi, cundaka, nipajjissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:4.40.1: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā cundako bhagavato paṭissutvā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapesi.
segments.dn16:4.40.2: Atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
segments.dn16:4.40.3: Āyasmā pana cundako tattheva bhagavato purato nisīdi.
segments.dn16:4.41.5: Nhatvā ca pivitvā cudatāri satthā [pivitvā cundakena, pivitvā ca uttari (ka.)],
segments.dn16:4.41.7: Vattā [satthā (sī. syā. pī.)] pavattā bhagavā idha dhamme,
segments.dn16:4.42.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:4.42.2: “siyā kho [yo kho (ka.)], panānanda, cundassa kammāraputtassa koci vippaṭisāraṃ uppādeyya –
segments.dn16:4.42.3: ‘tassa te, āvuso cunda, alābhā tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yassa te tathāgato pacchimaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjitvā parinibbuto’ti.
segments.dn16:4.42.4: Cundassa, ānanda, kammāraputtassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinetabbo –
segments.dn16:4.42.5: ‘tassa te, āvuso cunda, lābhā tassa te suladdhaṃ,
segments.dn16:4.42.6: yassa te tathāgato pacchimaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjitvā parinibbuto.
segments.dn16:4.42.7: Sammukhā metaṃ, āvuso cunda, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.dn16:4.42.8: dve me piṇḍapātā samasamaphalā [samā samaphalā (ka.)] samavipākā [samasamavipākā (sī. syā. pī.)], ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā ca.
segments.dn16:4.42.10: Yañca piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjitvā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañca piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjitvā tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati.
segments.dn16:4.42.11: Ime dve piṇḍapātā samasamaphalā samavipākā, ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā ca.
segments.dn16:4.42.12: Āyusaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, vaṇṇasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, sukhasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, yasasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, saggasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, ādhipateyyasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitan’ti.
segments.dn16:4.42.13: Cundassa, ānanda, kammāraputtassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinetabbo”ti.
segments.dn16:4.43.1: Atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi –
segments.dn16:5.1.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:5.1.2: “āyāmānanda, yena hiraññavatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, yena kusinārā upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ tenupasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.1.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn16:5.1.4: Atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena hiraññavatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, yena kusinārā upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:5.1.5: “iṅgha me tvaṃ, ānanda, antarena yamakasālānaṃ uttarasīsakaṃ mañcakaṃ paññapehi, kilantosmi, ānanda, nipajjissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:5.1.6: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā antarena yamakasālānaṃ uttarasīsakaṃ mañcakaṃ paññapesi.
segments.dn16:5.1.7: Atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno.
segments.dn16:5.2.1: Tena kho pana samayena yamakasālā sabbaphāliphullā honti akālapupphehi.
segments.dn16:5.2.2: Te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.2.3: Dibbānipi mandāravapupphāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.2.4: Dibbānipi candanacuṇṇāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.2.5: Dibbānipi tūriyāni antalikkhe vajjanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.2.6: Dibbānipi saṅgītāni antalikkhe vattanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.3.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:5.3.3: Te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.3.4: Dibbānipi mandāravapupphāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.3.5: Dibbānipi candanacuṇṇāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.3.6: Dibbānipi tūriyāni antalikkhe vajjanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.3.7: Dibbānipi saṅgītāni antalikkhe vattanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.3.8: Na kho, ānanda, ettāvatā tathāgato sakkato vā hoti garukato vā mānito vā pūjito vā apacito vā.
segments.dn16:5.3.9: Yo kho, ānanda, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhammānudhammappaṭipanno viharati sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti apaciyati [idaṃ padaṃ sīsyāipotthakesu na dissati], paramāya pūjāya.
segments.dn16:5.4.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavato purato ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ bījayamāno.
segments.dn16:5.4.2: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasāresi –
segments.dn16:5.4.5: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā upavāṇo dīgharattaṃ bhagavato upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpacārī.
segments.dn16:5.4.6: Atha ca pana bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasāreti –
segments.dn16:5.4.8: Ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo, yaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasāreti –
segments.dn16:5.5.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.5.2: ‘ayaṃ, bhante, āyasmā upavāṇo dīgharattaṃ bhagavato upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpacārī.
segments.dn16:5.5.3: Atha ca pana bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasāreti –
segments.dn16:5.5.5: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasāreti –
segments.dn16:5.5.7: “Yebhuyyena, ānanda, dasasu lokadhātūsu devatā sannipatitā tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
segments.dn16:5.5.8: Yāvatā, ānanda, kusinārā upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ samantato dvādasa yojanāni, natthi so padeso vālaggakoṭinitudanamattopi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi apphuṭo.
segments.dn16:5.5.11: Kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā.
segments.dn16:5.5.12: Ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
segments.dn16:5.5.13: Ayañca mahesakkho bhikkhu bhagavato purato ṭhito ovārento, na mayaṃ labhāma pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.6.1: “Kathaṃbhūtā pana, bhante, bhagavā devatā manasikarotī”ti [manasi karontīti (syā. ka.)]?
segments.dn16:5.6.2: “Santānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti [chinnaṃpādaṃviya papatanti (syā.)], āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:5.6.3: ‘atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ [cakkhumā (syā. ka.)] loke antaradhaṃāyissatī’ti.
segments.dn16:5.6.4: “Santānanda, devatā pathaviyaṃ pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:5.6.5: ‘atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatī’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.6.6: “Yā pana tā devatā vītarāgā, tā satā sampajānā adhivāsenti –
segments.dn16:5.7.1: “Pubbe, bhante, disāsu vassaṃ vuṭṭhā [vassaṃvutthā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] bhikkhū āgacchanti tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
segments.dn16:5.7.2: Te mayaṃ labhāma manobhāvanīye bhikkhū dassanāya, labhāma payirupāsanāya.
segments.dn16:5.7.3: Bhagavato pana mayaṃ, bhante, accayena na labhissāma manobhāvanīye bhikkhū dassanāya, na labhissāma payirupāsanāyā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.8.1: “Cattārimāni, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
segments.dn16:5.8.3: ‘Idha tathāgato jāto’ti, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.8.4: ‘Idha tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.8.5: ‘Idha tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitan’ti, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.8.6: ‘Idha tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto’ti, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.8.7: Imāni kho, ānanda, cattāri saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
segments.dn16:5.8.8: “Āgamissanti kho, ānanda, saddhā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo –
segments.dn16:5.8.9: ‘idha tathāgato jāto’ tipi,‘idha tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ tipi,‘idha tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitan’ tipi,‘idha tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto’ tipi.
segments.dn16:5.8.10: Ye hi keci, ānanda, cetiyacārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā pasannacittā kālaṅkarissanti, sabbe te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissantī”ti.
segments.dn16:5.10.3: Iṅgha tumhe, ānanda, sāratthe ghaṭatha anuyuñjatha [sadatthe anuyuñjatha (sī. syā.), sadatthaṃ anuyuñjatha (pī.), sāratthe anuyuñjatha (ka.)], sāratthe appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharatha.
segments.dn16:5.10.4: Santānanda, khattiyapaṇḍitāpi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitāpi gahapatipaṇḍitāpi tathāgate abhippasannā, te tathāgatassa sarīrapūjaṃ karissantī”ti.
segments.dn16:5.11.2: “Yathā kho, ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabban”ti.
segments.dn16:5.11.3: “Kathaṃ pana, bhante, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjantī”ti?
segments.dn16:5.11.4: “Rañño, ānanda, cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhenti, ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti.
segments.dn16:5.11.5: Etenupāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ [sarīre (syā. ka.)] veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.
segments.dn16:5.11.6: Cātumahāpathe [cātummahāpathe (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] rañño cakkavattissa thūpaṃ karonti.
segments.dn16:5.11.7: Evaṃ kho, ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti.
segments.dn16:5.11.8: Yathā kho, ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.11.10: Tattha ye mālaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā cuṇṇakaṃ [vaṇṇakaṃ (sī. pī.)] vā āropessanti vā abhivādessanti vā cittaṃ vā pasādessanti tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
segments.dn16:5.12.3: Tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūpāraho, paccekasambuddho thūpāraho, tathāgatassa sāvako thūpāraho, rājā cakkavattī [cakkavatti (syā. ka.)] thūpārahoti.
segments.dn16:5.12.4: “Kiñcānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūpāraho?
segments.dn16:5.12.5: ‘Ayaṃ tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa thūpo’ti, ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti.
segments.dn16:5.12.6: Te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.dn16:5.12.7: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūpāraho.
segments.dn16:5.12.9: ‘Ayaṃ tassa bhagavato paccekasambuddhassa thūpo’ti, ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti.
segments.dn16:5.12.10: Te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.dn16:5.12.11: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca paccekasambuddho thūpāraho.
segments.dn16:5.12.13: ‘Ayaṃ tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāvakassa thūpo’ti ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti.
segments.dn16:5.12.14: Te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.dn16:5.12.15: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgatassa sāvako thūpāraho.
segments.dn16:5.12.17: ‘Ayaṃ tassa dhammikassa dhammarañño thūpo’ti, ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti.
segments.dn16:5.12.18: Te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.dn16:5.12.19: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho.
segments.dn16:5.13.0: Ānandaacchariyadhammo Atha kho āyasmā ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno aṭṭhāsi –
segments.dn16:5.13.2: “ahañca vatamhi sekho sakaraṇīyo, satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati, yo mama anukampako”ti.
segments.dn16:5.13.5: “Eso, bhante, āyasmā ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno ṭhito –
segments.dn16:5.13.6: ‘ahañca vatamhi sekho sakaraṇīyo, satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati, yo mama anukampako’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.13.7: Atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:5.13.8: “ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mama vacanena ānandaṃ āmantehi –
segments.dn16:5.13.10: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.14.1: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā ānando tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.14.2: “alaṃ, ānanda, mā soci mā paridevi, nanu etaṃ, ānanda, mayā paṭikacceva akkhātaṃ –
segments.dn16:5.14.4: taṃ kutettha, ānanda, labbhā. Yaṃ taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ vata tathāgatassāpi sarīraṃ mā palujjī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.dn16:5.14.5: Dīgharattaṃ kho te, ānanda, tathāgato paccupaṭṭhito mettena kāyakammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena, mettena vacīkammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena, mettena manokammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena.
segments.dn16:5.14.6: Katapuññosi tvaṃ, ānanda, padhānamanuyuñja, khippaṃ hohisi anāsavo”ti.
segments.dn16:5.15.2: “yepi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tesampi bhagavantānaṃ etapparamāyeva upaṭṭhākā ahesuṃ, seyyathāpi mayhaṃ ānando.
segments.dn16:5.15.3: Yepi te, bhikkhave, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tesampi bhagavantānaṃ etapparamāyeva upaṭṭhākā bhavissanti, seyyathāpi mayhaṃ ānando.
segments.dn16:5.15.6: Jānāti ‘ayaṃ kālo tathāgataṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, ayaṃ kālo bhikkhunīnaṃ, ayaṃ kālo upāsakānaṃ, ayaṃ kālo upāsikānaṃ, ayaṃ kālo rañño rājamahāmattānaṃ titthiyānaṃ titthiyasāvakānan’ti.
segments.dn16:5.16.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā [abbhutadhammā (syā. ka.)] ānande.
segments.dn16:5.16.3: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.4: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.5: Atittāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.6: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhunīparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.7: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.8: Atittāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhunīparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.9: Sace, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.10: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.11: Atittāva, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.12: Sace, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.13: Tatra ce, ānando, dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.14: Atittāva, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.15: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
segments.dn16:5.16.16: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
segments.dn16:5.16.18: Sace, bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.19: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.20: Atittāva, bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā hoti. Atha kho rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.23: samaṇaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.24: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.25: Atittāva, bhikkhave, samaṇaparisā hoti, atha kho rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.26: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, cattārome acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
segments.dn16:5.16.27: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.28: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.33: upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.34: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.dn16:5.16.37: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande”ti.
segments.dn16:5.17.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.17.2: “mā, bhante, bhagavā imasmiṃ khuddakanagarake ujjaṅgalanagarake sākhānagarake parinibbāyi.
segments.dn16:5.17.4: campā rājagahaṃ sāvatthī sāketaṃ kosambī bārāṇasī;
segments.dn16:5.17.6: Ettha bahū khattiyamahāsālā, brāhmaṇamahāsālā gahapatimahāsālā tathāgate abhippasannā.
segments.dn16:5.18.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano nāma ahosi cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janappadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
segments.dn16:5.18.2: Rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa ayaṃ kusinārā kusāvatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi,
segments.dn16:5.18.3: puratthimena ca pacchimena ca dvādasayojanāni āyāmena; uttarena ca dakkhiṇena ca sattayojanāni vitthārena.
segments.dn16:5.18.4: Kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī iddhā ceva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
segments.dn16:5.18.5: Seyyathāpi, ānanda, devānaṃ āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā ceva hoti phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇayakkhā ca subhikkhā ca;
segments.dn16:5.18.6: evameva kho, ānanda, kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā ceva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
segments.dn16:5.18.7: Kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā ceva rattiñca, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.dn16:5.18.8: hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena ‘asnātha pivatha khādathā’ti dasamena saddena.
segments.dn16:5.19.1: “Gaccha tvaṃ, ānanda, kusināraṃ pavisitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocehi –
segments.dn16:5.19.2: ‘ajja kho, vāseṭṭhā, rattiyā pacchime yāme tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
segments.dn16:5.19.5: amhākañca no gāmakkhette tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ ahosi, na mayaṃ labhimhā pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.19.6: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya attadutiyo kusināraṃ pāvisi.
segments.dn16:5.20.1: Tena kho pana samayena kosinārakā mallā sandhāgāre [santhāgāre (sī. syā. pī.)] sannipatitā honti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
segments.dn16:5.20.2: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ sandhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocesi –
segments.dn16:5.20.3: “ajja kho, vāseṭṭhā, rattiyā pacchime yāme tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
segments.dn16:5.20.6: ‘amhākañca no gāmakkhette tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ ahosi, na mayaṃ labhimhā pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.21.1: Idamāyasmato ānandassa vacanaṃ sutvā mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā appekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:5.21.2: ‘atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatī’ti.
segments.dn16:5.21.3: Atha kho mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
segments.dn16:5.22.2: “sace kho ahaṃ kosinārake malle ekamekaṃ bhagavantaṃ vandāpessāmi, avandito bhagavā kosinārakehi mallehi bhavissati, athāyaṃ ratti vibhāyissati.
segments.dn16:5.22.3: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpeyyaṃ –
segments.dn16:5.22.4: ‘itthannāmo, bhante, mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
segments.dn16:5.22.5: Atha kho āyasmā ānando kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi –
segments.dn16:5.22.6: ‘itthannāmo, bhante, mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.22.7: Atha kho āyasmā ānando etena upāyena paṭhameneva yāmena kosinārake malle bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi.
segments.dn16:5.23.1: Tena kho pana samayena subhaddo nāma paribbājako kusinārāyaṃ paṭivasati.
segments.dn16:5.23.3: “ajja kira rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
segments.dn16:5.23.5: “sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.dn16:5.23.6: ‘kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā’ti.
segments.dn16:5.23.7: Ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
segments.dn16:5.23.8: Atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhādhammo uppanno,
segments.dn16:5.23.9: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe gotame,‘pahoti me samaṇo gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyan’”ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.1: Atha kho subhaddo paribbājako yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ, yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.24.2: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bho ānanda, paribbājakānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.dn16:5.24.3: ‘kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā’ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.4: Ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
segments.dn16:5.24.5: Atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhādhammo uppanno –
segments.dn16:5.24.6: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe gotame ‘pahoti me samaṇo gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyan’ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.7: Sādhāhaṃ, bho ānanda, labheyyaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.8: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.24.9: “alaṃ, āvuso subhadda, mā tathāgataṃ viheṭhesi, kilanto bhagavā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.11: tatiyampi kho subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.24.12: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bho ānanda, paribbājakānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.dn16:5.24.13: ‘kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā’ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.14: Ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
segments.dn16:5.24.15: Atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhādhammo uppanno –
segments.dn16:5.24.16: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe gotame,‘pahoti me samaṇo gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyan’ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.17: Sādhāhaṃ, bho ānanda, labheyyaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.24.18: Tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.24.19: “alaṃ, āvuso subhadda, mā tathāgataṃ viheṭhesi, kilanto bhagavā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.25.1: Assosi kho bhagavā āyasmato ānandassa subhaddena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.25.2: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:5.25.3: “alaṃ, ānanda, mā subhaddaṃ vāresi, labhataṃ, ānanda, subhaddo tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
segments.dn16:5.25.4: Yaṃ kiñci maṃ subhaddo pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ aññāpekkhova pucchissati, no vihesāpekkho.
segments.dn16:5.25.5: Yaṃ cassāhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi, taṃ khippameva ājānissatī”ti.
segments.dn16:5.25.6: Atha kho āyasmā ānando subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.26.1: Atha kho subhaddo paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho subhaddo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.26.2: “yeme, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa,
segments.dn16:5.26.3: seyyathidaṃ – pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, ajito kesakambalo, pakudho kaccāyano, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto,
segments.dn16:5.26.4: sabbete sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññiṃsu, sabbeva na abbhaññiṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññiṃsu, ekacce na abbhaññiṃsū”ti?
segments.dn16:5.26.6: ‘sabbete sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññiṃsu, sabbeva na abbhaññiṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññiṃsu, ekacce na abbhaññiṃsū’ti.
segments.dn16:5.26.9: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho subhaddo paribbājako bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn16:5.27.1: “Yasmiṃ kho, subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo na upalabbhati, samaṇopi tattha na upalabbhati. Dutiyopi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati. Tatiyopi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati. Catutthopi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati.
segments.dn16:5.27.2: Yasmiñca kho, subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo upalabbhati, samaṇopi tattha upalabbhati, dutiyopi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati, tatiyopi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati, catutthopi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati.
segments.dn16:5.27.3: Imasmiṃ kho, subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo upalabbhati, idheva, subhadda, samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo, idha tatiyo samaṇo, idha catuttho samaṇo, suññā parappavādā samaṇebhi aññehi [aññe (pī.)].
segments.dn16:5.27.4: Ime ca [idheva (ka.)], subhadda, bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti.
segments.dn16:5.27.15: Ime ca, subhadda, bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.28.1: Evaṃ vutte subhaddo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.28.3: Seyyathāpi, bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya,‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti, evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.dn16:5.28.4: Esāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.dn16:5.28.5: Labheyyāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan”ti.
segments.dn16:5.29.1: “Yo kho, subhadda, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati. Catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya.
segments.dn16:5.29.3: “Sace, bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. Ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.29.4: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:5.29.6: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn16:5.30.1: Atha kho subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:5.30.2: “lābhā vo, āvuso ānanda; suladdhaṃ vo, āvuso ānanda,
segments.dn16:5.30.3: ye ettha satthu [satthārā (syā.)] sammukhā antevāsikābhisekena abhisittā”ti.
segments.dn16:5.30.4: Alattha kho subhaddo paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
segments.dn16:5.30.5: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā subhaddo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva – ‘yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti’ tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
segments.dn16:5.30.6: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsi.
segments.dn16:5.30.7: Aññataro kho panāyasmā subhaddo arahataṃ ahosi.
segments.dn16:6.1.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:6.1.4: Na kho panetaṃ, ānanda, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.dn16:6.1.5: Yo vo, ānanda, mayā dhammo ca vinayo ca desito paññatto, so vo mamaccayena satthā.
segments.dn16:6.2.1: Yathā kho panānanda, etarahi bhikkhū aññamaññaṃ āvusovādena samudācaranti, na kho mamaccayena evaṃ samudācaritabbaṃ.
segments.dn16:6.2.2: Theratarena, ānanda, bhikkhunā navakataro bhikkhu nāmena vā gottena vā āvusovādena vā samudācaritabbo.
segments.dn16:6.2.3: Navakatarena bhikkhunā therataro bhikkhu ‘bhante’ti vā ‘āyasmā’ti vā samudācaritabbo.
segments.dn16:6.3.1: Ākaṅkhamāno, ānanda, saṅgho mamaccayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatu.
segments.dn16:6.4.1: Channassa, ānanda, bhikkhuno mamaccayena brahmadaṇḍo dātabbo”ti.
segments.dn16:6.4.3: “Channo, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ iccheyya, taṃ vadeyya.
segments.dn16:6.4.4: So bhikkhūhi neva vattabbo, na ovaditabbo, na anusāsitabbo”ti.
segments.dn16:6.5.2: “siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā, pucchatha, bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha –
segments.dn16:6.5.3: ‘sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimhā bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitun’”ti.
segments.dn16:6.5.4: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.6.3: “siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā, pucchatha, bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha –
segments.dn16:6.6.4: ‘sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimhā bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitun’”ti.
segments.dn16:6.6.5: Tatiyampi kho te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.6.7: “siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, satthugāravenapi na puccheyyātha. Sahāyakopi, bhikkhave, sahāyakassa ārocetū”ti.
segments.dn16:6.6.8: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.6.9: Atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:6.6.10: “acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ, bhante, imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe,‘natthi ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā’”ti.
segments.dn16:6.6.11: “Pasādā kho tvaṃ, ānanda, vadesi, ñāṇameva hettha, ānanda, tathāgatassa. Natthi imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā.
segments.dn16:6.6.12: Imesañhi, ānanda, pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ yo pacchimako bhikkhu, so sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
segments.dn16:6.8.1: Atha kho bhagavā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. Catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji, ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji, ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajji.
segments.dn16:6.8.2: Atha kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:6.9.1: Atha kho bhagavā saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji, ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji, ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā bhagavā parinibbāyi.
segments.dn16:6.10.1: Parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. Devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.10.2: Parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā brahmāsahampati imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.dn16:6.10.9: Parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā sakko devānamindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.dn16:6.10.14: Parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā āyasmā anuruddho imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.dn16:6.10.23: Parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā āyasmā ānando imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.dn16:6.10.28: Parinibbute bhagavati ye te tattha bhikkhū avītarāgā appekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti,“atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahito”ti.
segments.dn16:6.10.29: Ye pana te bhikkhū vītarāgā, te satā sampajānā adhivāsenti –
segments.dn16:6.11.1: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.dn16:6.11.3: Nanu etaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā paṭikacceva akkhātaṃ –
segments.dn16:6.11.5: Taṃ kutettha, āvuso, labbhā. ‘Yaṃ taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ vata mā palujjī’ti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.dn16:6.11.7: “Kathaṃbhūtā pana, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho devatā manasi karotī”ti [bhante anuruddha devatā manasi karontīti (syā. ka.)]?
segments.dn16:6.11.8: “Santāvuso ānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:6.11.9: ‘atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahito’ti.
segments.dn16:6.11.10: Santāvuso ānanda, devatā pathaviyā pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:6.11.11: ‘atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahito’ti.
segments.dn16:6.11.12: Yā pana tā devatā vītarāgā, tā satā sampajānā adhivāsenti –
segments.dn16:6.11.14: Atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca ānando taṃ rattāvasesaṃ dhammiyā kathāya vītināmesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.12.1: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn16:6.12.2: “gacchāvuso ānanda, kusināraṃ pavisitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocehi –
segments.dn16:6.12.5: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato anuruddhassa paṭissutvā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya attadutiyo kusināraṃ pāvisi.
segments.dn16:6.12.6: Tena kho pana samayena kosinārakā mallā sandhāgāre sannipatitā honti teneva karaṇīyena.
segments.dn16:6.12.7: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ sandhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocesi –
segments.dn16:6.12.10: Idamāyasmato ānandassa vacanaṃ sutvā mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā appekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:6.12.11: “atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahito”ti.
segments.dn16:6.13.1: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā purise āṇāpesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.13.2: “tena hi, bhaṇe, kusinārāyaṃ gandhamālañca sabbañca tāḷāvacaraṃ sannipātethā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.13.3: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā gandhamālañca sabbañca tāḷāvacaraṃ pañca ca dussayugasatāni ādāya yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ, yena bhagavato sarīraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā celavitānāni karontā maṇḍalamāḷe paṭiyādentā ekadivasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.13.5: “ativikālo kho ajja bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpetuṃ, sve dāni mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.13.6: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā celavitānāni karontā maṇḍalamāḷe paṭiyādentā dutiyampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, tatiyampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, catutthampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, pañcamampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, chaṭṭhampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.14.1: Atha kho sattamaṃ divasaṃ kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ etadahosi –
segments.dn16:6.14.2: “mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā dakkhiṇena dakkhiṇaṃ nagarassa haritvā bāhirena bāhiraṃ dakkhiṇato nagarassa bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.14.3: Tena kho pana samayena aṭṭha mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃnhātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
segments.dn16:6.14.4: “mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ uccāressāmā”ti na sakkonti uccāretuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.14.5: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.14.6: “ko nu kho, bhante anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo, yenime aṭṭha mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃnhātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
segments.dn16:6.14.7: ‘mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ uccāressāmā’ti na sakkonti uccāretun”ti?
segments.dn16:6.14.8: “Aññathā kho, vāseṭṭhā, tumhākaṃ adhippāyo, aññathā devatānaṃ adhippāyo”ti.
segments.dn16:6.15.3: ‘mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā dakkhiṇena dakkhiṇaṃ nagarassa haritvā bāhirena bāhiraṃ dakkhiṇato nagarassa bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā’ti;
segments.dn16:6.15.5: ‘mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ dibbehi naccehi gītehi vāditehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā uttarena uttaraṃ nagarassa haritvā uttarena dvārena nagaraṃ pavesetvā majjhena majjhaṃ nagarassa haritvā puratthimena dvārena nikkhamitvā puratthimato nagarassa makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ ettha bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā’ti.
segments.dn16:6.16.1: Tena kho pana samayena kusinārā yāva sandhisamalasaṃkaṭīrā jaṇṇumattena odhinā mandāravapupphehi santhatā [saṇṭhitā (syā.)] hoti.
segments.dn16:6.16.2: Atha kho devatā ca kosinārakā ca mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ dibbehi ca mānusakehi ca naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā uttarena uttaraṃ nagarassa haritvā uttarena dvārena nagaraṃ pavesetvā majjhena majjhaṃ nagarassa haritvā puratthimena dvārena nikkhamitvā puratthimato nagarassa makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ ettha ca bhagavato sarīraṃ nikkhipiṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.17.1: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.17.2: “kathaṃ mayaṃ, bhante ānanda, tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjāmā”ti?
segments.dn16:6.17.3: “Yathā kho, vāseṭṭhā, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabban”ti.
segments.dn16:6.17.4: “Kathaṃ pana, bhante ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjantī”ti?
segments.dn16:6.17.5: “Rañño, vāseṭṭhā, cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhenti, ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti.
segments.dn16:6.17.6: Etena upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.
segments.dn16:6.17.8: Evaṃ kho, vāseṭṭhā, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti.
segments.dn16:6.17.9: Yathā kho, vāseṭṭhā, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
segments.dn16:6.17.11: Tattha ye mālaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā cuṇṇakaṃ vā āropessanti vā abhivādessanti vā cittaṃ vā pasādessanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.18.1: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā purise āṇāpesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.18.2: “tena hi, bhaṇe, mallānaṃ vihataṃ kappāsaṃ sannipātethā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.18.3: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhesuṃ, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.18.4: Etena upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi bhagavato sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā bhagavato sarīraṃ citakaṃ āropesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.19.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggappaṭippanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
segments.dn16:6.19.2: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
segments.dn16:6.19.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro ājīvako kusinārāya mandāravapupphaṃ gahetvā pāvaṃ addhānamaggappaṭippanno hoti.
segments.dn16:6.19.4: Addasā kho āyasmā mahākassapo taṃ ājīvakaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ, disvā taṃ ājīvakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn16:6.19.8: Tattha ye te bhikkhū avītarāgā appekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti –
segments.dn16:6.19.9: “atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahito”ti.
segments.dn16:6.19.10: Ye pana te bhikkhū vītarāgā, te satā sampajānā adhivāsenti –
segments.dn16:6.20.1: Tena kho pana samayena subhaddo nāma vuddhapabbajito tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
segments.dn16:6.20.2: Atha kho subhaddo vuddhapabbajito te bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.dn16:6.20.3: “alaṃ, āvuso, mā socittha, mā paridevittha, sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena. Upaddutā ca homa –
segments.dn16:6.20.4: ‘idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī’ti.
segments.dn16:6.20.5: Idāni pana mayaṃ yaṃ icchissāma, taṃ karissāma, yaṃ na icchissāma, na taṃ karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.20.6: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.dn16:6.20.8: Nanu etaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā paṭikacceva akkhātaṃ –
segments.dn16:6.20.10: Taṃ kutettha, āvuso, labbhā. ‘Yaṃ taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ tathāgatassāpi sarīraṃ mā palujjī’ti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī”ti.
segments.dn16:6.21.1: Tena kho pana samayena cattāro mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃnhātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā –
segments.dn16:6.21.2: “mayaṃ bhagavato citakaṃ āḷimpessāmā”ti na sakkonti āḷimpetuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.21.3: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.21.4: “ko nu kho, bhante anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo, yenime cattāro mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃnhātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā –
segments.dn16:6.21.5: ‘mayaṃ bhagavato citakaṃ āḷimpessāmā’ti na sakkonti āḷimpetun”ti?
segments.dn16:6.21.9: ‘ayaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggappaṭippanno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
segments.dn16:6.21.10: Na tāva bhagavato citako pajjalissati, yāvāyasmā mahākassapo bhagavato pāde sirasā na vandissatī’”ti.
segments.dn16:6.22.1: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo yena kusinārā makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ, yena bhagavato citako tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ citakaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandi.
segments.dn16:6.22.2: Tānipi kho pañcabhikkhusatāni ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ citakaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandiṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.22.3: Vandite ca panāyasmatā mahākassapena tehi ca pañcahi bhikkhusatehi sayameva bhagavato citako pajjali.
segments.dn16:6.23.1: Jhāyamānassa kho pana bhagavato sarīrassa yaṃ ahosi chavīti vā cammanti vā maṃsanti vā nhārūti vā lasikāti vā, tassa neva chārikā paññāyittha, na masi;
segments.dn16:6.23.3: Seyyathāpi nāma sappissa vā telassa vā jhāyamānassa neva chārikā paññāyati, na masi;
segments.dn16:6.23.4: evameva bhagavato sarīrassa jhāyamānassa yaṃ ahosi chavīti vā cammanti vā maṃsanti vā nhārūti vā lasikāti vā, tassa neva chārikā paññāyittha, na masi;
segments.dn16:6.23.6: Tesañca pañcannaṃ dussayugasatānaṃ dveva dussāni na ḍayhiṃsu yañca sabbaabbhantarimaṃ yañca bāhiraṃ.
segments.dn16:6.23.7: Daḍḍhe ca kho pana bhagavato sarīre antalikkhā udakadhārā pātubhavitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
segments.dn16:6.23.8: Udakasālatopi [udakaṃ sālatopi (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] abbhunnamitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
segments.dn16:6.23.9: Kosinārakāpi mallā sabbagandhodakena bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.23.10: Atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīrāni sattāhaṃ sandhāgāre sattipañjaraṃ karitvā dhanupākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā [parikkhipitvā (syā.)] naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkariṃsu garuṃ kariṃsu mānesuṃ pūjesuṃ.
segments.dn16:6.24.1: Assosi kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto –
segments.dn16:6.24.3: Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesi –
segments.dn16:6.24.4: “bhagavāpi khattiyo ahampi khattiyo, ahampi arahāmi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, ahampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:6.24.7: Atha kho vesālikā licchavī kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.24.8: “bhagavāpi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.24.11: Atha kho kapilavatthuvāsī sakyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.24.12: “bhagavā amhākaṃ ñātiseṭṭho, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.24.15: Atha kho allakappakā bulayo kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.24.16: “bhagavāpi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.24.19: Atha kho rāmagāmakā koḷiyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.24.20: “bhagavāpi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.24.23: Atha kho veṭṭhadīpako brāhmaṇo kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesi –
segments.dn16:6.24.24: “bhagavāpi khattiyo ahaṃ pismi brāhmaṇo, ahampi arahāmi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, ahampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:6.24.27: Atha kho pāveyyakā mallā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.24.28: “bhagavāpi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.25.1: Evaṃ vutte kosinārakā mallā te saṅghe gaṇe etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.25.2: “bhagavā amhākaṃ gāmakkhette parinibbuto, na mayaṃ dassāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgan”ti.
segments.dn16:6.25.3: Evaṃ vutte doṇo brāhmaṇo te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca –
segments.dn16:6.25.12: “Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, tvaññeva bhagavato sarīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ savibhattaṃ vibhajāhī”ti.
segments.dn16:6.25.13: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho doṇo brāhmaṇo tesaṃ saṅghānaṃ gaṇānaṃ paṭissutvā bhagavato sarīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajitvā te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca –
segments.dn16:6.25.14: “imaṃ me bhonto tumbaṃ dadantu ahampi tumbassa thūpañca mahañca karissāmī”ti.
segments.dn16:6.25.15: Adaṃsu kho te doṇassa brāhmaṇassa tumbaṃ.
segments.dn16:6.26.3: Atha kho pippalivaniyā moriyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ –
segments.dn16:6.26.4: “bhagavāpi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
segments.dn16:6.26.5: “Natthi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgo, vibhattāni bhagavato sarīrāni.
segments.dn16:6.27.1: Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājagahe bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akāsi.
segments.dn16:6.27.2: Vesālikāpi licchavī vesāliyaṃ bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.3: Kapilavatthuvāsīpi sakyā kapilavatthusmiṃ bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.4: Allakappakāpi bulayo allakappe bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.5: Rāmagāmakāpi koḷiyā rāmagāme bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.6: Veṭṭhadīpakopi brāhmaṇo veṭṭhadīpe bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akāsi.
segments.dn16:6.27.7: Pāveyyakāpi mallā pāvāyaṃ bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.8: Kosinārakāpi mallā kusinārāyaṃ bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.9: Doṇopi brāhmaṇo tumbassa thūpañca mahañca akāsi.
segments.dn16:6.27.10: Pippalivaniyāpi moriyā pippalivane aṅgārānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
segments.dn16:6.27.11: Iti aṭṭha sarīrathūpā navamo tumbathūpo dasamo aṅgārathūpo.
segments.dn16:6.28.15: Taṃ vandatha [taṃ taṃ vandatha (syā.)] pañjalikā labhitvā,

lines: Tatrāyamanupubbapadavaṇṇanā – gijjhakūṭeti gijjhā tassa kūṭesu vasiṃsu, gijjhasadisaṃ vā tassa kūṭaṃ atthīti gijjhakūṭo, tasmiṃ gijjhakūṭe.
Evaṃmahiddhiketi evaṃ mahatiyā rājiddhiyā samannāgate, etena nesaṃ samaggabhāvaṃ kathesi.
Evaṃmahānubhāveti evaṃ mahantena ānubhāvena samannāgate, etena nesaṃ hatthisippādīsu katasikkhataṃ kathesi, yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ –
“sikkhitā vatime licchavikumārakā, susikkhitā vatime licchavikumārakā, yatra hi nāma sukhumena tāḷacchiggalena asanaṃ atipātayissanti poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitan”ti (saṃ. ni.5.1115).
Anayabyasananti ettha na ayoti anayo, avaḍḍhiyā etaṃ nāmaṃ.
Hitañca sukhañca viyassati vikkhipatīti byasanaṃ, ñātipārijuññādīnaṃ etaṃ nāmaṃ.
Iti kira so ṭhānanisajjādīsu imaṃ yuddhakathameva katheti, gamanasajjā hothāti evaṃ balakāyaṃ āṇāpeti.
Gaṅgāyaṃ kira ekaṃ paṭṭanagāmaṃ nissāya aḍḍhayojanaṃ ajātasattuno āṇā, aḍḍhayojanaṃ licchavīnaṃ.
“ajja yāmi, sve yāmī”ti ajātasattuno saṃvidahantasseva licchavirājāno samaggā sammodamānā puretaraṃ gantvā sabbaṃ gaṇhanti.
Ajātasattu pacchā āgantvā taṃ pavattiṃ ñatvā kujjhitvā gacchati.

“gaṇena saddhiṃ yuddhaṃ nāma bhāriyaṃ, ekopi moghappahāro nāma natthi, ekena kho pana paṇḍitena saddhiṃ mantetvā karonto nipparādho hoti, paṇḍito ca satthārā sadiso natthi, satthā ca avidūre dhuravihāre vasati, handāhaṃ pesetvā pucchāmi.
Sace me gatena koci attho bhavissati, satthā tuṇhī bhavissati, anatthe pana sati kiṃ rañño tattha gamanenāti vakkhatī”ti.
Bhagavantaṃ bījayamānoti thero vattasīse ṭhatvā bhagavantaṃ bījati, bhagavato pana sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā natthi.
Bhagavā brāhmaṇassa vacanaṃ sutvā tena saddhiṃ amantetvā therena saddhiṃ mantetukāmo kinti te, ānanda, sutantiādimāha.
Abhiṇhaṃ sannipātāti divasassa tikkhattuṃ sannipatantāpi antarantarā sannipatantāpi abhiṇhaṃ sannipātāva.
Sannipātabahulāti hiyyopi sannipatimhā, purimadivasampi sannipatimhā, puna ajja kimatthaṃ sannipatitā homāti vosānaṃ anāpajjantā sannipātabahulā nāma honti.
Vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānīti – abhiṇhaṃ asannipatantā hi disāvidisāsu āgataṃ sāsanaṃ na suṇanti, tato –
“asukagāmasīmā vā nigamasīmā vā ākulā, asukaṭṭhāne corā vā pariyuṭṭhitā”ti na jānanti, corāpi “pamattā rājāno”ti ñatvā gāmanigamādīni paharantā janapadaṃ nāsenti.
Abhiṇhaṃ sannipatantā pana taṃ taṃ pavattiṃ suṇanti, tato balaṃ pesetvā amittamaddanaṃ karonti, corāpi –
“appamattā rājāno, na sakkā amhehi vaggabandhehi vicaritun”ti bhijjitvā palāyanti.
Tattha pāṭikaṅkhāti icchitabbā, avassaṃ bhavissatīti evaṃ daṭṭhabbāti attho.
“ajja me kiccaṃ atthi, maṅgalaṃ atthī”ti vikkhepaṃ karontā na samaggā sannipatanti nāma.
Bherisaddaṃ pana sutvāva bhuñjantāpi alaṅkariyamānāpi vatthāni nivāsentāpi aḍḍhabhuttā vā aḍḍhālaṅkatā vā vatthaṃ nivāsayamānā vā sannipatantā samaggā sannipatanti nāma.
Sannipatitā pana cintetvā mantetvā kattabbaṃ katvā ekatova avuṭṭhahantā na samaggā vuṭṭhahanti nāma.
Evaṃ vuṭṭhitesu hi ye paṭhamaṃ gacchanti, tesaṃ evaṃ hoti –
Ekato vuṭṭhahantā pana samaggā vuṭṭhahanti nāma.
“asukaṭṭhānesu gāmasīmā vā nigamasīmā vā ākulā, corā pariyuṭṭhitā”ti sutvā –
“ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ, ahaṃ paṭhaman”ti vatvā gacchantāpi samaggā vuṭṭhahanti nāma.
Ekassa pana kammante osīdamāne sesā rājāno puttabhātaro pesetvā tassa kammantaṃ upatthambhayamānāpi, āgantukarājānaṃ –

“asukassa gehaṃ gacchatu, asukassa gehaṃ gacchatū”ti avatvā sabbe ekato saṅgaṇhantāpi, ekassa maṅgale vā roge vā aññasmiṃ vā pana tādise sukhadukkhe uppanne sabbe tattha sahāyabhāvaṃ gacchantāpi samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karonti nāma.
Apaññattantiādīsu pubbe akataṃ suṅkaṃ vā baliṃ vā daṇḍaṃ vā āharāpentā apaññattaṃ paññapenti nāma.
Porāṇapaveṇiyā āgatameva pana anāharāpentā paññattaṃ samucchindanti nāma.
Coroti gahetvā dassite avicinitvāva chejjabhejjaṃ anusāsentā porāṇaṃ vajjidhammaṃ samādāya na vattanti nāma.
Tesaṃ apaññattaṃ paññapentānaṃ abhinavasuṅkādīhi pīḷitā manussā –
“atiupaddutamha, ko imesaṃ vijite vasissatī”ti paccantaṃ pavisitvā corā vā corasahāyā vā hutvā janapadaṃ paharanti.
Paññattaṃ samucchindantānaṃ paveṇīāgatāni suṅkādīni agaṇhantānaṃ koso parihāyati.
Tato hatthiassabalakāyaorodhādayo yathānibaddhaṃ vaṭṭaṃ alabhamānā thāmena balena parihāyanti.
Te neva yuddhakkhamā honti, na pāricariyakkhamā.
Porāṇaṃ vajjidhammaṃ samādāya avattantānaṃ vijite manussā –

“amhākaṃ puttaṃ pitaraṃ bhātaraṃ acoraṃyeva coroti katvā chindiṃsu bhindiṃsū”ti kujjhitvā paccantaṃ pavisitvā corā vā corasahāyā vā hutvā janapadaṃ paharanti, evaṃ rājūnaṃ parihāni hoti, paññattaṃ paññapentānaṃ pana “paveṇīāgatameva rājāno karontī”ti manussā haṭṭhatuṭṭhā kasivāṇijjādike kammante sampādenti.

Paññattaṃ asamucchindantānaṃ paveṇīāgatāni suṅkādīni gaṇhantānaṃ koso vaḍḍhati, tato hatthiassabalakāyaorodhādayo yathānibaddhaṃ vaṭṭaṃ labhamānā thāmabalasampannā yuddhakkhamā ceva pāricariyakkhamā ca honti.
Porāṇaṃ vajjidhammanti ettha pubbe kira vajjirājāno “ayaṃ coro”ti ānetvā dassite “gaṇhatha naṃ coran”ti avatvā vinicchayamahāmattānaṃ denti.
Te vinicchinitvā sace acoro hoti, vissajjenti.
Sace coro, attanā kiñci avatvā vohārikānaṃ denti.
Tepi tatheva katvā senāpatissa, senāpati uparājassa, uparājā rañño, rājā vinicchinitvā acoro ce, vissajjeti.
Sace pana coro hoti, paveṇīpotthakaṃ vācāpeti.
“yena idaṃ nāma kataṃ, tassa ayaṃ nāma daṇḍo”ti likhitaṃ.
Rājā tassa kiriyaṃ tena samānetvā tadanucchavikaṃ daṇḍaṃ karoti.
Iti etaṃ porāṇaṃ vajjidhammaṃ samādāya vattantānaṃ manussā na ujjhāyanti,“rājāno porāṇapaveṇiyā kammaṃ karonti, etesaṃ doso natthi, amhākaṃyeva doso”ti appamattā kammante karonti.
Sakkarontīti yaṃkiñci tesaṃ sakkāraṃ karontā sundarameva karonti.
Sotabbaṃ maññantīti divasassa dve tayo vāre upaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā tesaṃ kathaṃ sotabbaṃ saddhātabbaṃ maññanti.
Tattha ye evaṃ mahallakānaṃ rājūnaṃ sakkārādīni na karonti, ovādatthāya ca nesaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ na gacchanti, te tehi vissaṭṭhā anovadiyamānā kīḷāpasutā rajjato parihāyanti.
Ye pana tathā paṭipajjanti, tesaṃ mahallakarājāno –
“idaṃ kātabbaṃ, idaṃ na kātabban”ti porāṇaṃ paveṇiṃ ācikkhanti.
Te tehi ovadiyamānā yathāovādaṃ paṭipajjantā sakkonti rājappaveṇiṃ sandhāretuṃ.
Okkassa pasayhāti ettha “okkassā”ti vā “pasayhā”ti vā pasayhākārassevetaṃ nāmaṃ.

“amhākaṃ gehe puttamātaropi, kheḷasiṅghāṇikādīni mukhena apanetvā saṃvaḍḍhitadhītaropi ime rājāno balakkārena gahetvā attano ghare vāsentī”ti kupitā paccantaṃ pavisitvā corā vā corasahāyā vā hutvā janapadaṃ paharanti.
Evaṃ akarontānaṃ pana vijite manussā appossukkā sakāni kammāni karontā rājakosaṃ vaḍḍhenti.
Vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyānīti vajjirājūnaṃ vajjiraṭṭhe cittīkataṭṭhena cetiyānīti laddhanāmāni yakkhaṭṭhānāni.

No parihāpessantīti aparihāpetvā yathāpavattameva karissanti dhammikaṃ baliṃ parihāpentānañhi devatā ārakkhaṃ susaṃvihitaṃ na karonti, anuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ janetuṃ asakkontāpi uppannaṃ kāsasīsarogādiṃ vaḍḍhenti, saṅgāme patte sahāyā na honti.
Aparihāpentānaṃ pana ārakkhaṃ susaṃvihitaṃ karonti, anuppannaṃ sukhaṃ uppādetuṃ asakkontāpi uppannaṃ kāsasīsarogādiṃ hananti, saṅgāmasīse sahāyā hontīti evamettha vuddhihāniyo veditabbā.
Dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇaguttīti ettha rakkhā eva yathā anicchitaṃ na gacchati, evaṃ āvaraṇato āvaraṇaṃ.
Yathā icchitaṃ na vinassati, evaṃ gopāyanato gutti.
Tattha balakāyena parivāretvā rakkhaṇaṃ pabbajitānaṃ dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti nāma na hoti.
Yathā pana vihārassa upavane rukkhe na chindanti, vājikā vajjhaṃ na karonti, pokkharaṇīsu macche na gaṇhanti, evaṃ karaṇaṃ dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti nāma.
Kinti anāgatā cāti iminā pana nesaṃ evaṃ paccupaṭṭhitacittasantānoti cittappavattiṃ pucchati.
Tattha ye anāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ āgamanaṃ na icchanti, te assaddhā honti appasannā.

Pabbajite ca sampatte paccuggamanaṃ na karonti, gantvā na passanti, paṭisanthāraṃ na karonti, pañhaṃ na pucchanti, dhammaṃ na suṇanti, dānaṃ na denti, anumodanaṃ na suṇanti, nivāsanaṭṭhānaṃ na saṃvidahanti.
“asuko nāma rājā assaddho appasanno, pabbajite sampatte paccuggamanaṃ na karoti … pe … nivāsanaṭṭhānaṃ na saṃvidahatī”ti.
Taṃ sutvā pabbajitā tassa nagaradvārena na gacchanti, gacchantāpi nagaraṃ na pavisanti.
Āgatānampi phāsuvihāre asati yepi ajānitvā āgatā, te –
“vasissāmāti tāva cintetvā āgatamhā, imesaṃ pana rājūnaṃ iminā nīhārena ko vasissatī”ti nikkhamitvā gacchanti.
Evaṃ anāgatesu anāgacchantesu, āgatesu dukkhaṃ viharantesu so deso pabbajitānaṃ anāvāso hoti.
Tato devatārakkhā na hoti, devatārakkhāya asati amanussā okāsaṃ labhanti.
Amanussā ussannā anuppannaṃ byādhiṃ uppādenti, sīlavantānaṃ dassanapañhāpucchanādivatthukassa puññassa anāgamo hoti.
Vipariyāyena pana yathāvuttakaṇhapakkhaviparītassa sukkapakkhassa sambhavo hotīti evamettha vuddhihāniyo veditabbā.
Ekamidāhanti idaṃ bhagavā pubbe vajjīnaṃ imassa vajjisattakassa desitabhāvappakāsanatthamāha.
Anuppanne kira buddhe tattha sārandadassa yakkhassa nivāsanaṭṭhānaṃ cetiyaṃ ahosi.
Athettha bhagavato vihāraṃ kārāpesuṃ, so sārandade cetiye katattā sārandadacetiyantveva saṅkhyaṃ gato.
Yuddhassāti karaṇatthe sāmivacanaṃ, abhimukhayuddhena gahetuṃ na sakkāti attho.
“alaṃ vivādena, idāni samaggā homā”ti hatthiassarathahiraññasuvaṇṇādīni pesetvā saṅgahakaraṇaṃ.
Evañhi saṅgahaṃ katvā kevalaṃ vissāsena sakkā gaṇhitunti attho.
Iminā aññamaññabhedaṃ katvāpi sakkā ete gahetunti dasseti.
Idaṃ brāhmaṇo bhagavato kathāya nayaṃ labhitvā āha.
Kiṃ pana bhagavā brāhmaṇassa imāya kathāya nayalābhaṃ na jānātīti?

“mayā akathitepi katipāhena gantvā sabbe gaṇhissati, kathite pana samagge bhindanto tīhi saṃvaccharehi gaṇhissati, ettakampi jīvitameva varaṃ, ettakañhi jīvantā attano patiṭṭhānabhūtaṃ puññaṃ karissantī”ti.
“yathā bho samaṇassa gotamassa vacanaṃ na sakkā vajjī kenaci gahetuṃ, api ca upalāpanāya vā mithubhedena vā sakkā”ti āha.
“upalāpanāya amhākaṃ hatthiassādayo nassissanti, bhedeneva te gahessāmi, kiṃ karomā”ti pucchi.
Tena hi, mahārāja, tumhe vajjiṃ ārabbha parisati kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpetha.
“kiṃ te mahārāja tehi, attano santakehi kasivāṇijjādīni katvā jīvantu ete rājāno”ti vatvā pakkamissāmi.

“kinnu kho bho esa brāhmaṇo vajjiṃ ārabbha pavattaṃ kathaṃ paṭibāhatī”ti vadeyyātha, divasabhāge cāhaṃ tesaṃ paṇṇākāraṃ pesessāmi, tampi gāhāpetvā tumhepi mama dosaṃ āropetvā bandhanatālanādīni akatvāva kevalaṃ khuramuṇḍaṃ maṃ katvā nagarā nīharāpetha.
“mayā te nagare pākāro parikhā ca kāritā, ahaṃ kira dubbalaṭṭhānañca uttānagambhīraṭṭhānañca jānāmi, na cirasseva dāni ujuṃ karissāmī”ti vakkhāmi.
“saṭho brāhmaṇo, mā tassa gaṅgaṃ uttarituṃ adatthā”ti āhaṃsu.
“amhe ārabbha kathitattā kira so evaṃ kato”ti vutte “tena hi, bhaṇe, etū”ti bhaṇiṃsu.
So gantvā licchavī disvā “kiṃ āgatatthā”ti pucchito taṃ pavattiṃ ārocesi, licchavino –
“appamattakena nāma evaṃ garuṃ daṇḍaṃ kātuṃ na yuttan”ti vatvā –
So suṭṭhutaraṃ vinicchayaṃ karoti, rājakumārā tassa santike sippaṃ uggaṇhanti.
So patiṭṭhitaguṇo hutvā ekadivasaṃ ekaṃ licchaviṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ gantvā – dārakā kasantīti pucchi.
“kiṃ ācariyo āhā”ti pucchitvā tena vuttaṃ asaddahanto “na me esa yathābhūtaṃ kathetī”ti tena saddhiṃ bhijji.
Brāhmaṇo aññasmiṃ divase ekaṃ licchaviṃ ekamantaṃ netvā –
Tampi añño pucchitvā asaddahanto tatheva bhijji.
Brāhmaṇo aparampi divasaṃ ekaṃ licchaviṃ ekamantaṃ netvā –
Ko evamāhāti pucchito asuko nāma licchavīti.
Evaṃ aññena akathitameva aññassa kathento tīhi saṃvaccharehi te rājāno aññamaññaṃ bhinditvā yathā dve ekamaggena na gacchanti, tathā katvā sannipātabheriṃ carāpesi.
“issarā sannipatantu, sūrā sannipatantū”ti vatvā na sannipatiṃsu.
“ayaṃ dāni kālo, sīghaṃ āgacchatū”ti rañño sāsanaṃ pesesi.
“rañño gaṅgaṃ uttarituṃ na dassāmā”ti bheriṃ carāpesuṃ.
“Nagarappavesanaṃ na dassāma, dvārāni pidahitvā ṭhassāmā”ti bheriṃ carāpesuṃ.
Yathāvivaṭeheva dvārehi pavisitvā sabbe anayabyasanaṃ pāpetvā gato.
Atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantetiādimhi sannipātetvāti dūravihāresu iddhimante pesetvā santikavihāresu sayaṃ gantvā –
Dhamme desessāmīti candasahassaṃ sūriyasahassaṃ uṭṭhapento viya catukuṭṭake gehe anto teladīpasahassaṃ ujjālento viya pākaṭe katvā kathayissāmīti.
Idhāpi ca abhiṇhaṃ asannipatitā disāsu āgatasāsanaṃ na suṇanti.

“asukavihārasīmā ākulā, uposathapavāraṇā ṭhitā, asukasmiṃ ṭhāne bhikkhū vejjakammadūtakammādīni karonti, viññattibahulā pupphadānādīhi jīvikaṃ kappentī”tiādīni na jānanti, pāpabhikkhūpi “pamatto bhikkhusaṅgho”ti ñatvā rāsibhūtā sāsanaṃ osakkāpenti.

Abhiṇhaṃ sannipatitā pana taṃ taṃ pavattiṃ suṇanti, tato bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pesetvā sīmaṃ ujuṃ karonti, uposathapavāraṇādayo pavattāpenti, micchājīvānaṃ ussannaṭṭhāne ariyavaṃsake pesetvā ariyavaṃsaṃ kathāpenti, pāpabhikkhūnaṃ vinayadharehi niggahaṃ kārāpenti, pāpabhikkhūpi “appamatto bhikkhusaṅgho, na sakkā amhehi vaggabandhena vicaritun”ti bhijjitvā palāyanti.
Samaggātiādīsu cetiyapaṭijagganatthaṃ vā bodhigehauposathāgāracchādanatthaṃ vā katikavattaṃ vā ṭhapetukāmatāya ovādaṃ vā dātukāmatāya –
“saṅgho sannipatatū”ti bheriyā vā ghaṇṭiyā vā ākoṭitāya –
“mayhaṃ cīvarakammaṃ atthi, mayhaṃ patto pacitabbo, mayhaṃ navakammaṃ atthī”ti vikkhepaṃ karontā na samaggā sannipatanti nāma.
“ahaṃ purimataraṃ, ahaṃ purimataran”ti ekappahāreneva sannipatantā samaggā sannipatanti nāma.
Sannipatitā pana cintetvā mantetvā kattabbaṃ katvā ekato avuṭṭhahantā samaggā na vuṭṭhahanti nāma.
Evaṃ vuṭṭhitesu hi ye paṭhamaṃ gacchanti, tesaṃ evaṃ hoti –
Ekappahāreneva vuṭṭhahantā pana samaggā vuṭṭhahanti nāma.
Apica “asukaṭṭhāne vihārasīmā ākulā, uposathapavāraṇā ṭhitā, asukaṭṭhāne vejjakammādikārakā pāpabhikkhū ussannā”ti sutvā –
“ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ, ahaṃ paṭhaman”ti vatvā gacchantāpi samaggā vuṭṭhahanti nāma.

“imaṃ pariveṇaṃ yāhi, etaṃ pariveṇaṃ yāhi, ayaṃ ko”ti avatvā sabbe vattaṃ karontāpi, jiṇṇapattacīvarakaṃ disvā tassa bhikkhācāravattena pattacīvaraṃ pariyesamānāpi, gilānassa gilānabhesajjaṃ pariyesamānāpi, gilānameva anāthaṃ –

“asukapariveṇaṃ yāhi, asukapariveṇaṃ yāhī”ti avatvā attano attano pariveṇe paṭijaggantāpi, eko oliyamānako gantho hoti, paññavantaṃ bhikkhuṃ saṅgaṇhitvā tena taṃ ganthaṃ ukkhipāpentāpi samaggā saṅghaṃ karaṇīyāni karonti nāma.
Apaññattantiādīsu navaṃ adhammikaṃ katikavattaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ vā bandhantā apaññattaṃ paññapenti nāma, purāṇasanthatavatthusmiṃ sāvatthiyaṃ bhikkhū viya.
Uddhammaṃ ubbinayaṃ sāsanaṃ dīpentā paññattaṃ samucchindanti nāma, vassasataparinibbute bhagavati vesālikā vajjiputtakā viya.
Khuddānukhuddakā pana āpattiyo sañcicca vītikkamantā yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya na vattanti nāma, assajipunabbasukā viya.

Navaṃ pana katikavattaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ vā abandhantā, dhammavinayato sāsanaṃ dīpentā, khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni asamūhanantā apaññattaṃ na paññapenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattanti nāma, āyasmā upaseno viya, āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto viya ca.
“Suṇātu, me āvuso saṅgho, santamhākaṃ sikkhāpadāni gihigatāni, gihinopi jānanti,‘idaṃ vo samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī’ti.
Sace hi mayaṃ khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanissāma, bhavissanti vattāro –
‘dhūmakālikaṃ samaṇena gotamena sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ, yāvimesaṃ satthā aṭṭhāsi, tāvime sikkhāpadesu sikkhiṃsu.
Yato imesaṃ satthā parinibbuto, na dānime sikkhāpadesu sikkhantī’ti.
Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho apaññattaṃ na paññapeyya, paññattaṃ na samucchindeyya, yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vatteyyā”ti (cuḷava.442)–
Imaṃ tantiṃ ṭhapayanto āyasmā mahākassapo viya ca.
Pituṭṭhāne ṭhitattā saṅghaṃ parinenti pubbaṅgamā hutvā tīsu sikkhāsu pavattentīti saṅghapariṇāyakā.
Ye tesaṃ sakkārādīni na karonti, ovādatthāya dve tayo vāre upaṭṭhānaṃ na gacchanti, tepi tesaṃ ovādaṃ na denti, paveṇīkathaṃ na kathenti, sārabhūtaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na sikkhāpenti.
Te tehi vissaṭṭhā sīlādīhi dhammakkhandhehi sattahi ca ariyadhanehīti evamādīhi guṇehi parihāyanti.
Ye pana tesaṃ sakkārādīni karonti, upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchanti, tepi tesaṃ ovādaṃ denti.

“Evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te ālokitabbaṃ, evaṃ te vilokitabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban”ti paveṇīkathaṃ kathenti, sārabhūtaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sikkhāpenti, terasahi dhutaṅgehi dasahi kathāvatthūhi anusāsanti.
Te tesaṃ ovāde ṭhatvā sīlādīhi guṇehi vaḍḍhamānā sāmaññatthaṃ anupāpuṇanti.
Punabbhavadānaṃ punabbhavo, punabbhavo sīlamassāti ponobbhavikā, punabbhavadāyikāti attho, tasmā ponobbhavikāya.
Na vasaṃ gacchantīti ettha ye catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ kāraṇā upaṭṭhākānaṃ padānupadikā hutvā gāmato gāmaṃ vicaranti, te tassā taṇhāya vasaṃ gacchanti nāma, itare na gacchanti nāma.
Gāmantasenāsanesu hi jhānaṃ appetvāpi tato vuṭṭhitamattova itthipurisadārikādisaddaṃ suṇāti, yenassa adhigatavisesopi hāyatiyeva.
Araññe pana niddāyitvā paṭibuddhamatto sīhabyagghamorādīnaṃ saddaṃ suṇāti, yena āraññakaṃ pītiṃ labhitvā tameva sammasanto aggaphale patiṭṭhāti.
Iti bhagavā gāmantasenāsane jhānaṃ appetvā nisinnabhikkhuno araññe niddāyantameva pasaṃsati.
Paccattaññeva satiṃ upaṭṭhapessantīti attanāva attano abbhantare satiṃ upaṭṭhapessanti.
Idhāpi sabrahmacārīnaṃ āgamanaṃ anicchantā nevāsikā assaddhā honti appasannā.
Sampattabhikkhūnaṃ paccuggamanapattacīvarappaṭiggahaṇaāsanapaññāpanatālavaṇṭaggahaṇādīni na karonti, atha nesaṃ avaṇṇo uggacchati –
“asukavihāravāsino bhikkhū assaddhā appasannā vihāraṃ paviṭṭhānaṃ vattapaṭivattaṃ na karontī”ti.
Taṃ sutvā pabbajitā vihāradvārena gacchantāpi vihāraṃ na pavisanti.
Āgatānaṃ pana phāsuvihāre asati yepi ajānitvā āgatā, te –
“vasissāmāti tāva cintetvā āgatāmha, imesaṃ pana nevāsikānaṃ iminā nīhārena ko vasissatī”ti nikkhamitvā gacchanti.
Evaṃ so vihāro aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anāvāsova hoti.
Tato nevāsikā sīlavantānaṃ dassanaṃ alabhantā kaṅkhāvinodanaṃ vā ācārasikkhāpakaṃ vā madhuradhammassavanaṃ vā na labhanti, tesaṃ neva aggahitadhammaggahaṇaṃ, na gahitasajjhāyakaraṇaṃ hoti.
Iti nesaṃ hāniyeva hoti, na vuddhi.

Ye pana sabrahmacārīnaṃ āgamanaṃ icchanti, te saddhā honti pasannā, āgatānaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ paccuggamanādīni katvā senāsanaṃ paññapetvā denti, te gahetvā bhikkhācāraṃ pavisanti, kaṅkhaṃ vinodenti, madhuradhammassavanaṃ labhanti.
Taṃ sutvā bhikkhū dūratopi enti, tesaṃ nevāsikā vattaṃ karonti, samīpaṃ āgantvā vuḍḍhataraṃ āgantukaṃ vanditvā nisīdanti, navakatarassa santike āsanaṃ gahetvā nisīdanti.
“sappāyaṃ senāsanaṃ, sulabhā bhikkhā”tiādīni vatvā gantuṃ na denti.
Vinayadharo ce hoti, tassa santike vinayaṃ sajjhāyanti.
Suttantādidharo ce, tassa santike taṃ taṃ dhammaṃ sajjhāyanti.
Āgantukānaṃ therānaṃ ovāde ṭhatvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇanti.
Āgantukā “ekaṃ dve divasāni vasissāmāti āgatāmha, imesaṃ pana sukhasaṃvāsatāya dasadvādasavassāni vasissāmā”ti vattāro honti.
Seyyathidaṃ – cīvaravicāraṇaṃ, cīvarakaraṇaṃ, upatthambhanaṃ, sūcigharaṃ, pattatthavikaṃ, asaṃbaddhakaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ, dhamakaraṇaṃ, ādhārakaṃ, pādakathalikaṃ, sammajjanīādīnaṃ karaṇanti.
Ekacco hi etāni karonto sakaladivasaṃ etāneva karoti.

Yo pana etesaṃ karaṇavelāyameva etāni karoti, uddesavelāyaṃ uddesaṃ gaṇhāti, sajjhāyavelāyaṃ sajjhāyati, cetiyaṅgaṇavattavelāyaṃ cetiyaṅgaṇavattaṃ karoti, manasikāravelāyaṃ manasikāraṃ karoti, na so kammārāmo nāma.
Na bhassārāmāti ettha yo itthivaṇṇapurisavaṇṇādivasena ālāpasallāpaṃ karontoyeva divasañca rattiñca vītināmeti, evarūpe bhasse pariyantakārī na hoti, ayaṃ bhassārāmo nāma.
Yo pana rattindivaṃ dhammaṃ katheti, pañhaṃ vissajjeti, ayaṃ appabhassova bhasse pariyantakārīyeva.
